tooltip.golems_arsenal.key_sword: Deals more damage the lower the enemy's health is
tooltip.golems_arsenal.shen_tong_staff: Grants +10% attack damage per Black Monkey upgrade installed
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_energy.desc: Adds FE capacity; capacity increases with upgrade level.
upgrade.golems_arsenal.e_tank.desc: The golem can store repair materials and use them in combat
upgrade.golems_arsenal.e_tank.capacity: Capacity: %s repair materials (each restores 25%% max HP)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.e_tank.threshold: Above %s%% HP materials are stored instead of consumed (avoids waste)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.light_pillar.desc: After taking damage: four light pillars rise around the golem and grant immunity while they last; the pillars also damage enemies they touch
upgrade.golems_arsenal.golem_energy_tech: While holding the katana: powered hits trigger a lightning chain that applies Weakness and can repeat hits on the same target
While holding the Zero blade: melee attacks bypass armor, and each tech level adds extra attack damage
While holding the hammer: reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount
While holding the bow: powered arrows explode on hit, converting projectile damage into explosion damage
upgrade.golems_arsenal.backup_energy.des: Grants an absorb shield (max %s points) that soaks incoming damage; every %s seconds it consumes FE to restore %s shield points (%s FE per point), and damage interrupts the recharge for %s seconds; scales with level
upgrade.golems_arsenal.main_weapon.desc: Swords, axes, the flame sword and the forge hammer deal extra damage equal to a percentage of the golem's max health; the flame sword leaves a magic flame cloud on hit
upgrade.golems_arsenal.main_weapon.desc_: Sword-tag weapons also grant +1 entity reach and +1 sweep range
upgrade.golems_arsenal.alt_weapon.desc: Golem spears splash area damage around the struck target, and the sculk golem scythe deals bonus damage
upgrade.golems_arsenal.ranged_weapon.des: Arrows shot by a golem bow fly faster, raising arrow damage via the vanilla velocity damage formula; holding the Sonic Cannon (Echo Cannon) boosts magic damage
upgrade.golems_arsenal.shield_weapon.des: Successful blocks restore shield durability based on the golem's armor and toughness, on a cooldown
upgrade.golems_arsenal.full_onslaught.de: While armor exceeds the threshold, each excess armor point plus toughness grants melee attack and percentage TACZ gun damage (configurable)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.cavalry.desc: While riding a golem mount the golem's melee damage scales with the mount's speed; golem spears turn that into a damage multiplier that grows with speed, and bows or crossbows fire arrows at double speed
upgrade.golems_arsenal.tech_expansion.de: Each level grants 1 extra upgrade slot but reduces max health by 10%
upgrade.golems_arsenal.scroll.desc: Right-click a golem holding this upgrade with a scroll to record a spell; the golem casts it in combat (requires Golem Magicka)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.stance.desc: Attacking, moving and being hurt fill the stance gauge; a full gauge grants one stance stack. Melee attacks consume all stacks for magic damage proportional to the hit, and arrows carry the stacks into magic damage on hit (works better with the Shen Tong Staff)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.stance.desc_lv1: Level 1: up to 3 stacks, flame particles around the golem show the current count
upgrade.golems_arsenal.stance.desc_lv2: Level 2: stack cap raised to 4, completing the flame particle ring
upgrade.golems_arsenal.stance_sub.desc: Requires Black Monkey: Stance; attacks absorbed by invulnerability frames grant one stance point
upgrade.golems_arsenal.key_blade_spin.de: The golem throws its key blade at enemies
upgrade.golems_arsenal.lion_slash.desc: The golem uses Lion Slash to destroy enemies
upgrade.golems_arsenal.sword_rain.desc: The golem throws its key blade up to summon sword rain
upgrade.golems_arsenal.charge.desc: The golem charges through its target, which sits in the middle of the dash, damaging every enemy on the way; three dashes with the key blade, and a blink with the energy katana that always refreshes the charge cooldown on a kill and can do so by chance
message.golems_arsenal.mystic_mastered: The golem has mastered this skill; it is time to go further
message.golems_arsenal.mystic_authorized: The golem's flames burn a little hotter...
upgrade.golems_arsenal.phoenix.desc: The golem leaps backwards and up with a backflip, then dives down onto its target with a fiery, explosive impact; the rise only deals a small fire hit that ignores invulnerability
jei.golems_arsenal.synergy.weakened: When both are equipped, the upgrade effect is slightly weakened
jei.golems_arsenal.gilded_onslaught.head: While wearing the Gilded set:
jei.golems_arsenal.gilded_onslaught.desc: The golem accumulates damage taken; once the total reaches a threshold it gains a burst of armor (+10%~30%)
upgrade.golems_arsenal.graze.desc: When a projectile grazes the golem, it briefly gains attack speed and short invulnerability
upgrade.golems_arsenal.train.desc:
Each nearby mechanical golem increases its own damage (up to five golems counted), shares damage taken with nearby mechanical golems, and makes them more likely to be attacked
Mechanical golems need fuel in hand (or inventory)
message.golems_arsenal.stance_charge: Stance charged (%s stacks), next attack is empowered!
upgrade.golems_arsenal.energy_saver.desc: All FE costs reduced by %s%% per level
upgrade.golems_arsenal.w_tank.desc: E Tank companion: converts stored repair materials into golem energy
upgrade.golems_arsenal.w_tank.convert: When the golem is below half FE, 1 stored material is converted into %s FE
upgrade.golems_arsenal.w_tank.set: Equip with Shock Buffer II, Energy Saver II and the E Tank to trigger the Omega synergy
set.golems_arsenal.omega: Omega synergy: E Tank gains 1 material every 60s; damage raises four light pillars for 2s (5s cooldown); Genmu Zero usable once every 30s

death.attack.phoenix_impact: %1$s was roasted into a cooked porkchop
death.attack.phoenix_impact.player: %1$s was roasted into a cooked porkchop by %2$s

death.attack.lion_slash.player: %2$s crushed %1$s to death while learning Lion Slash

death.attack.sword_rain.player: %1$s was riddled into a sieve by %2$s's sword rain

death.attack.key_sword_magic.player: %1$s took one of %2$s's secret arts to the face
death.attack.flame_magic: %1$s was cooked in a flame cloud
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_katana.cos: Powered hits consume %s FE and grant Charge
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_katana.tec: +%s%% attack damage per tech level while wielding this weapon
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_katana.cha: Powered hits grant Charge to the holder for %s seconds
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_hammer.def: Damage above %s%% of max HP consumes energy to reduce it by %s%%
tooltip.golems_arsenal.energy_hammer.reg: Restores %s%% max HP per second per tech level
tooltip.golems_arsenal.tracking_bow.trac: Powered arrows track the golem's target
tooltip.golems_arsenal.zero_sword.tech_a: +%s%% attack damage per tech level while wielding this weapon
tooltip.golems_arsenal.zero_sword.charge: After %s seconds without attacking, the next hit deals %sx damage
